subject.facility_name: ARK HEALTHCARE & REHABILITATION AT GOVERNORS HOUSE

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $183.68 per resident day (42.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 2.4% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $627,333, 14.3% of the $4,376,021 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $740,177, $31.07 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $412,494 (55.7%), allocated fringe $103,982 (14.0%), non-wage costs $223,701 (30.2%). Raw food was $180,175 ($7.56 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $16,786.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $293,998, $12.34 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $187,593 (63.8%), allocated fringe $47,289 (16.1%), non-wage costs $59,116 (20.1%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $81,748, $3.43 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $81,748 (100.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2022 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; revenue lines do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2022 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; balance sheet does not add up). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
